name: mod-af
description: A collection of Claude Code plugins (mods) built the mod route — independent slash commands and hooks.

plugins.name: detell
plugins.description: Adversarially strip AI-writing tells from a file, looping until a clean pass; re-checks the evolving tells source on a cadence.

plugins.name: decide
plugins.description: Decision brief for any choice: real options, honest pros/cons (reversibility + cost-if-wrong), a committed recommendation and why, plus a durable decision record. Non-technical-friendly.

plugins.name: loose-ends
plugins.description: Anti-decay audit: find everything that lives only in this conversation and should be implemented now or filed with a concrete trigger.

plugins.name: route
plugins.description: Route to a milestone: what's actually left, the real gate named plainly, hard-blockers vs nice-to-haves, and the critical path when several things remain.
